# ============================================================================
# CANDIDATES, NOT SOURCES. Nothing in this file is crawled.
#
# These 1,552 Oracle Recruiting Cloud triples were recovered by a research pass
# in a container with no outbound access to job boards, so not one of them was
# probed by this project. docs/adding-a-source.md is explicit that a slug nobody
# has verified must not be registered, and at this project's fan-out a dead
# tenant is not free: it burns a request every crawl, reports as a failing
# source, and enough of them together trip the Source Health workflow's
# 35%-failure alarm, which is the signal that is supposed to mean a real
# platform broke.
#
# The 30 highest-volume triples from this file's hand-curated, industry-grouped
# head are registered in internal/services/oracle_orc.go as OracleCloudTenants.
# The rest are staged here until a CI job — the only place in this project with
# real network access — can probe them. Note that a large part of this file was
# merged by an automated apply-URL harvest and is annotated
# "[resolved needs_human]"; those entries need more scrutiny than the rest, not
# less, and none of them is registered.
#
# Promotion rule, gated on content and not on status code: keep a triple whose
# recruitingCEJobRequisitions list answers with items[0].TotalJobsCount above
# zero.
#
# The verification claims and posting counts below are the upstream curator's,
# dated as annotated. They are recorded as provenance, not endorsed.
# ============================================================================
#
# Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC / Oracle Fusion "Candidate Experience") tenants.
# One `company,fa-host,siteNumber` triple per line (# = comment, inline OK).
# Read by download/fetch_oracle_orc.py. Large own-domain enterprise boards that
# the Greenhouse/Lever/SmartRecruiters/Workable/iCIMS lanes miss (complementary to
# Workday). fa-host + siteNumber are found by following the company's public
# careers URL and reading the embedded oraclecloud.com host + CX_NNNN / named site.
# All live-verified (recruitingCEJobRequisitions TotalJobsCount > 0). Job counts
# (~N) are point-in-time at curation. NOTE: siteNumber may be CX_N or a named site.
#
